annotations.title: Get upload URLs for Untappd check-in photos

description: Get signed upload URLs for check-in photos — the way to attach a photo on the HOSTED connector, which cannot read files on your machine. For each photo (JPEG or PNG, max 15 MB) it returns a blobKey and a ready curl command: run the curl with the path to the photo (it must send exactly the returned Content-Type), then pass the blobKey to untappd_checkin as photo_blob_key. URLs expire after 30 minutes. Posts nothing to Untappd. Only available where the deployment provides a blob store; on a local install use photo_path or photo_inline.

slots.description: One entry per photo to upload (at most 10): {filename, mimeType?}. JPEG or PNG only.

filename.description: Filename the upstream will show — a bare name, no path, not starting with a dot.

mimeType.description: MIME type. Default: inferred from the filename extension. The PUT must send exactly this Content-Type.

name: untappd_upload_slots
